protocol: Retrospective class-stratified 40/20 partition. Prior threshold sweeps included all 60 claims, so the 20-claim subset is not an independent test set. CIs use class-stratified paired bootstrap.

evaluation_status.threshold_selection: Current run selected neural_fallback_threshold=0.50 on its 40-claim development partition; prior experiments swept thresholds on the full 60-claim sample before this partition existed.
evaluation_status.historical_data_reuse_note: All 60 examples, including this 20-claim diagnostic subset, appeared in earlier threshold sweeps. Do not report this subset as untouched, independent, or held out.
evaluation_status.bootstrap_ci_method: Class-stratified paired non-parametric percentile bootstrap (n=1000, alpha=0.05); describes sampling variability only and does not correct historical data reuse.

dev_sweep.selection_criterion: Maximizes Macro-F1 on the 40-claim development split
